baseline_adapter: OpenRouter /api/v1/messages; same original model, request and parser; isolated adapter explicitly authorized
threshold_policy: 0.95 chosen before measurement; no tuning on confirmation

limitations: Two timed-out Jev attempts across runs are recorded separately; first attempt baseline usage/latency was not retained.
Success-row aggregates exclude transport failures and standalone successful probe; they are not total session spend or end-to-end production latency.
Nine calibration pairs and forty confirmation pairs, four confirmation cases per category; threshold fixed before measurement.
